name: Landlord Tenant Commission - Jun 01, 2026
agenda_text:
AGENDA

  BURBANK LANDLORD-TENANT COMMISSION
  COMMUNITY SERVICES BUILDING
  150 N. THIRD STREET, COMMUNITY ROOM #104
  BURBANK, CA 91502

  Monday, June 1, 2026
  6:15 p.m.

This agenda contains a summary of each item of business that the Burbank Landlord-Tenant
Commission may discuss or act on at this meeting. All other written documentation relating to
each item on this agenda is on file in the Housing Office located at 150 N. Third Street, Second
Floor, Burbank, CA. These documents are available for public inspection and review. If you have
any questions about any matter on the agenda, please call Maribel Leyland, Housing Authority
Manager, at 818.238.5160. This facility is disabled accessible. In compliance with the Americans
with Disabilities Act, if any special assistance is needed to participate in this meeting, please
contact the ADA Coordinator at 818.238.5021 voice or 818.238.5035 TDD. Notification 48 hours
in advance of this meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements for special
assistance.

Interpretation Requests:
If you would like to participate in Public Comments and require an interpreter, please telephone
the City Clerk’s Office at (818) 238-5851 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting.
Si desea participar en los comentarios públicos y necesita un intérprete, por favor llame a la
Oficina de la Secretaria Municipal al (818) 238-5851 al menos 48 horas antes de la reunión.
Եթե ցանկանում եք մասնակցել հանրային մեկնաբանություններին և թարգմանիչ եք
պահանջում, խնդրում ենք զանգահարել քաղաքապետարանի գրասենյակ՝ (818) 238-5851
հեռախոսահամարով հանդիպումից 48 ժամ առաջ:

In lieu of in-person attendance, members of the public may participate in the oral
communication portion of the meeting via web conference. Please click the following link
to access the meeting:

https://burbankca.zoom.us/j/83815336927?pwd=cjdUN0tFa1AxcERHL3hQSmU3aEl5QT09
You may also participate in oral communication by calling +1 669 444 9171 or +1 719 359
4580 or +1 720 707 2699

Webinar ID: 838 1533 6927
Passcode: 645747

Public Comment: To speak during the Public Comment period during the meeting, use the link
above to join the web conference by 6:15 pm. City staff will connect speakers with the Board Chair
when the public comment part of the agenda is announced.

  a. Participants wishing to speak during public comment will be called upon by their screen
  name or the last four digits of their phone number, whichever information is available to
  the meeting host, to address the committee in real-time.
  b. To notify the meeting host that you wish to speak during the Public Comment period:
   •  Use the “raise hand” function if joining via the Zoom link above using a computer
  or mobile device.
  •  Dial *9 once the public comment period begins if joining using the Zoom dial-in
  numbers above via telephone.

  CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL

1. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  [This is the public’s opportunity to speak]
  During this portion of the agenda, any person may address the Commission on any matter
  concerning the Commission’s business or on any matter which is on the agenda. If you wish to
  speak during this portion of the agenda, you will be given five (5) minutes to address your
  concerns. The Commission requests that you observe the order and decorum of our meeting
  location and that you refrain from making personal, impertinent, or slanderous remarks.
  Boisterous and disruptive behavior while the Commission is in session is a violation of our
  Municipal Code and any person who engages in such conduct can be ordered to leave by the
  Chairperson. Your participation in the Landlord-Tenant Commission meeting is welcomed and
  your courtesy will be appreciated.

2. COMMISSION AND STAFF COMMENTS ON ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Responses to oral communications must be brief (less than 2 minutes) and non-substantive.
  Commission members may not deliberate responses.

3. NEW LANDLORD-TENANT FORMS
  None

4. FOLLOW-UP ON PRIOR MONTH LANDLORD-TENANT FORMS
  2026-6 Tenant Form – Commissioner Johnson and Nahabedian
  Address: 385 Bethanny Rd. Unit D, Burbank, CA 91504
  Issue: Security deposit mediation.

5. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Approval of the minutes from the meeting held on May 4, 2026.

6. COMMISSION AND STAFF ANNOUNCEMENTS
  Brief announcements by Commissioners and staff.

7. INTRODUCTION OF ADDITIONAL AGENDA ITEMS
  At this time additional items to be considered at this meeting may be introduced. The Commission
  may not have a discussion and/or take action on any item which does not appear on this agenda.

  ADJOURNMENT TO MONDAY, July 6, 2026, AT 6:15 P.M. IN THE COMMUNITY
  SERVICES BUILDING, 150 N. THIRD STREET, COMMUNITY ROOM #104, BURBANK, CA
  91502.
